# Experimental cross-government software OKF+

24,019 distinct repositories from 212 hosting accounts.

- Experimental metadata discovery; classifications are unreviewed term matches.
- Hosting accounts are not verified legal organisations or service owners.
- Missing licences and NOASSERTION do not establish reuse permission.
- Pushed dates, stars, SBOM paths and archive flags do not establish quality, security or support.
- The repository feed does not contain all guidance linked from the community resources page.
- The source fetch time and HTTP Last-Modified do not verify every upstream record was refreshed.

[Typed OKF core concepts](okf-core-explorer.json) · [Core taxonomy question and visual source trail](walkthrough/core-taxonomy.html) · [Notification software evidence walkthrough](walkthrough/notification-software.html) · [Domains and tasks](concepts/index.md) · [Source quality](quality.json) · [Semantic graph](semantic/manifest.json)
